name: strider
drawCalls: 2 (body with 14 rigid bones + jet plumes; +1 outline in B/C)
notes: Hovering digitigrade biped with twin-pod jetpack. Leg joints are damped springs driven by the hover bob, the root's world acceleration and idle sway (sub-stepped, no per-frame allocation). Weak point on the back sits behind two shutters that open with weakPointOpen. weakPointLocal and muzzlesLocal[2] are updated in place every frame.
